$comment: Flow map for Chrome-driven automation of the Shiftko app (no URL routing exists — App.jsx holds all navigation as in-memory state, so every flow below starts from a specific base app state; see README.md for how to get there). Keep this file hand-in-sync with data-testid attributes in src/: whenever a flow's UI changes, update the testid in the component AND the matching step here in the same change.

sign-in.description: Sign in with an existing account.
sign-in.assumesBaseState: Signed out, app showing Screen0 (the initial 'Built for nurses' welcome screen).

steps.note: Screen0's 'I already have an account' button. Sets App's authView to 'signin', which renders <Auth initialView="signin">.
Auth.jsx sign-in form email field.
Auth.jsx sign-in form password field.

Submits supabase.auth.signInWithPassword. On success, session is set and App renders Home (or another tab) via BottomNav; on failure an inline error message appears above this button (no testid on the error text).

Screen0's 'Get Started' button. Sets App's authView to 'signup', which renders <Auth initialView="signup">. NOTE: src/pages/onboarding/OnboardingFlow.jsx (Screen2-6, ScreenCredential) is NOT wired into App.jsx today — it is dead code — so sign-up goes straight from Screen0 to the Auth form, not through any onboarding screens.
Auth.jsx sign-up form email field.
Auth.jsx sign-up form password field.

Submits supabase.auth.signUp with role 'nurse'. If Supabase requires email confirmation, the view swaps to a plain 'Check your email to confirm your account' message (no testid there). Otherwise the session is set immediately and App renders Home.

claim-shift.description: Claim an open shift from the Pool.
claim-shift.assumesBaseState: Signed in as a nurse, on the Home tab, with at least one open shift in the pool for the nurse's home unit.

steps.note: Home's QuickActionTiles 'Claim Shifts' tile. Calls App's onGoToPool, which sets activeTab to 'pool' directly (no nav-pool click needed).

Pool.jsx's per-row Claim button. IMPORTANT: as of the current code, Pool's shift rows (ShiftCard) are NOT clickable/navigable to ShiftDetail — only this Claim/Withdraw button is interactive, so this flow does not pass through ShiftDetail. Multiple open shifts share this same testid; scope to a specific row (e.g. via read_page/get_page_text) if more than one is open. On success the row shows 'Requested' plus a pool-withdraw-claim button; on failure (race with another nurse) an inline 'This shift is no longer available.' message appears.

add-personal-event.description: Log a personal/self-scheduled shift from Home.
add-personal-event.assumesBaseState: Signed in, on the Home tab.

steps.note: Home's QuickActionTiles 'Add a Shift' tile. Opens the PersonalEventPanel bottom sheet over Home.

Optional. Switches the Department segmented control from the default 'Set Department' to 'No Department', which reveals a free-text event-name field instead of the unit <select>. Skip this step to keep the default department mode (unit defaults to 'Unit 1').

Only rendered/required when 'No Department' is selected above. If you skipped that step, fill personal-event-unit-select instead (a <select>, not a fill target for text automation — pick an option value).
Time input; defaults to 18:00 already so this step is optional.
Time input; defaults to 22:00 already so this step is optional.

Saves via createPersonalEvent (lib/personalEvents.js). Date defaults to today (calendar-day-<today> in CalendarStrip is pre-selected, no click needed) unless changed. On success the panel closes and Home's onSaved fires (no visible confirmation banner).

view-schedule.description: Open the Schedule tab and note its sub-tabs/views.

steps.note: BottomNav tab. For a nurse (role !== 'coordinator'), Schedule renders ScheduleTab directly — there's only one top-level pseudo-tab so no schedule-tab-* bar is shown. For a coordinator, a top tab bar appears with testids schedule-tab-team, schedule-tab-manage (Team Schedule / Manage). Staff has its own pushed screen now, reached from the Manage tab, not a Schedule tab.

Nurse-only. ScheduleTab renders one persistent header (title, list/calendar toggle, and this My Shifts / Team Schedule segmented control — testids schedule-view-mine, schedule-view-team; defaults to schedule-view-mine) above whichever sub-tab body is active, so switching never remounts or hides the header — only the body below swaps and shows its own loading state. Not present for a coordinator, who instead uses schedule-tab-team from the previous step (that screen has its own separate top tab bar and header, not this one).

Toggles between list (schedule-content-view-list, default) and month-calendar (schedule-content-view-calendar) rendering of the same shift/personal-event data. This is ONE shared state across both My Shifts and Team Schedule (owned by ScheduleTab's persistent header) — switching sub-tabs keeps whichever of list/calendar was already selected, it doesn't reset. Team Schedule's calendar day-detail rows show whose shift each row is (name + credential, or 'Open · tap to claim'), since it spans every nurse.

Optional — only once the calendar toggle above is active. Selects a day cell in the month grid (MonthCalendarGrid, shared by both My Shifts and Team Schedule's calendar view) and updates the day-detail panel below it. Compute the target date as YYYY-MM-DD and substitute it, e.g. calendar-day-2026-09-12. Same testid convention as the CalendarStrip date picker elsewhere in the app (see README.md) — never mounted at the same time, so no ambiguity.
BottomNav 'Profile' tab (id 'more').
Calls supabase.auth.signOut(). App's onAuthStateChange listener clears the session and the app falls back to Screen0 (authView resets are not needed since session becomes null).

coordinator-post-shift.description: Post an open (unassigned) shift as a coordinator. Fully wired in PostShift.jsx, its own pushed screen reached from Home.
coordinator-post-shift.assumesBaseState: Signed in as a coordinator (role === 'coordinator'), on Home.

steps.note: Home quick-action tile. Pushes PostShift as a full-screen overlay with the 'Post a Shift' form.

Selects 'Leave Open' in the Assign segmented control, which hides the Nurse select — the resulting shift lands in the Pool for any nurse on the unit to claim. Skip this step to instead leave 'Assign Nurse' selected and pick a nurse from the (untestid'd) Nurse <select>.
Selects the 'Day' shift preset (7:00 AM-3:30 PM). Also the default value, but click to be explicit; other options are schedule-manage-shift-preset-evening and schedule-manage-shift-preset-night.

REQUIRED — the form's date starts empty, so a date must be picked from the CalendarStrip before submitting will succeed. Compute today's local date as YYYY-MM-DD and substitute it into this testid, e.g. calendar-day-2026-09-08. Any future date's cell works the same way: calendar-day-<that date>.
Submits the shift. On success shows a 'Shift posted successfully.' message and the form resets, staying on this screen.
